product_overview: ConvAudit is an Arabic-first SaaS that helps ecommerce store owners audit product pages for conversion, SEO, AI visibility, and trust. Users can sign in, complete onboarding, run page audits, review recommendations, compare against competitors, and generate improved copy.
core_goals: Understand the product’s value from the public marketing site
Sign in and complete initial onboarding
Submit a product page for GEO audit
Review audit scores, recommendations, and competitor comparison
Generate AI-assisted content from audit findings
View audit history, workspace stats, and account settings

features.name: Marketing Landing
features.description: Public Arabic RTL landing page that explains the product, highlights how it works, and encourages visitors to start an audit or sign in.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll through landing sections -> Review product explanation and social proof -> Open pricing information -> Start analysis or sign in
Navigate to / -> Scroll through landing sections -> Verify the Arabic RTL layout -> Review how the product works -> Continue to a next step from the primary call to action

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Email-based magic link sign-in and Google sign-in for accessing the authenticated app.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth -> Enter email -> Request a magic link -> Complete sign-in -> See redirect to the dashboard or onboarding
Navigate to /auth -> Choose Google sign-in -> Complete the sign-in flow -> See redirect to the dashboard or onboarding

features.name: Onboarding Wizard
features.description: Multi-step onboarding that collects the store URL, platform, and user goals before entering the workspace.
user_flows: Navigate to /onboarding -> Enter store URL -> Continue to platform selection -> Confirm the ecommerce platform -> Select goals -> Complete onboarding -> See the onboarding completion screen

Navigate to /onboarding -> Enter store URL -> Continue to platform selection -> Select an ecommerce platform -> Continue to goal selection -> Select goals -> Finish onboarding -> Continue to the dashboard

features.name: New Audit
features.description: Authenticated flow for submitting a product page URL so the app can run a GEO audit.
user_flows: Navigate to /audit/new -> Paste a product page URL -> Submit the audit request -> See scanning progress
Navigate to /audit/new -> Paste an unsafe or invalid URL -> Submit the audit request -> See validation feedback -> Correct the URL -> Submit again -> See scanning progress

features.name: Audit Report
features.description: Authenticated report experience showing conversion, SEO, AI visibility, and trust scores with recommendations, competitor comparison, and AI-generated content.
user_flows: Navigate to /audit/[id]/report -> View the score modules and recommendations -> Review the audit findings -> Open the competitor comparison view

Navigate to /audit/[id]/report -> View the score modules and recommendations -> Open the competitor comparison view -> Return to the report -> Generate AI content from the findings -> Review the generated copy

features.name: Dashboard and History
features.description: Authenticated workspace views for monitoring recent audits, opening past audits, and managing audit actions.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View recent audits and scores -> Open a recent audit
Navigate to /history -> Review past audits -> Open an audit from the list -> Perform an audit action such as rerun or delete -> Return to the history list

features.name: Billing and Checkout
features.description: Authenticated billing area for viewing current plan and usage, choosing an upgrade, and completing payment.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings/billing -> Review current plan and usage quota -> Choose an upgrade plan -> Continue to checkout -> Complete payment flow
Navigate to /settings/usage -> Review usage limits and quota consumption -> Decide to upgrade -> Navigate to billing and checkout

features.name: Settings Profile
features.description: Authenticated profile settings for viewing and updating account details.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Review profile fields -> Update account information -> Save the changes -> See the updated profile state

features.name: Content and Trust Pages
features.description: Public help, blog, policy, and trust pages that let visitors learn about the product and verify company information.
user_flows: Navigate to /docs -> Browse documentation topics -> Open a related blog post -> Return to the blog index
Navigate to /privacy -> Read the privacy policy -> Navigate to /security -> Review security practices -> Navigate to /status -> Check current system status
Navigate to /roadmap -> Review planned work -> Navigate to /changelog -> Review recent updates -> Navigate to /affiliate -> Learn about the affiliate program

routes.description: Marketing landing page (Arabic RTL) with hero, product demo, pricing CTA
Authenticated workspace dashboard with recent audits and scores
Start a new product-page GEO audit by URL
Live scanning progress for an audit
Full audit report with scores and recommendations

features.name: Marketing Landing
features.description: Arabic RTL landing explaining GEO audits, how it works, social proof, and CTAs
user_interactions: Click navigation anchors (product, how it works, methodology, security, pricing)
Click primary CTA to start analysis / login
Switch or verify Arabic RTL layout

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Sign in via email magic link or Google OAuth through Supabase
user_interactions: Enter email and request magic link
Redirect to dashboard or onboarding after success

features.name: Onboarding Wizard
features.description: Multi-step onboarding for store URL, platform detection, and goals
user_interactions: Complete onboarding and continue to dashboard

features.name: New Audit
features.description: Submit a product page URL to run Firecrawl + Gemini GEO analysis
user_interactions: See validation errors for unsafe/invalid URLs

features.name: Audit Report
features.description: View scores (conversion, SEO, AI visibility, trust), recommendations, compare, generate content
user_interactions: Generate AI content and copy results

features.name: Dashboard and History
features.description: Overview of workspace stats and past audits with row actions

features.name: Billing and Checkout
features.description: View plan, usage quota, and pay via Kashier

features.name: Content and Trust Pages
features.description: Public docs, blog, privacy, security, status, roadmap, changelog, affiliate

known_limitations.issue: Authenticated flows require a real Supabase session; automated tests without credentials cannot fully exercise dashboard/audit/checkout
known_limitations.impact: Auth-gated pages redirect to /auth; deep audit flows need seeded test account

known_limitations.issue: Payment webhooks and Kashier live checkout cannot be fully verified without payment sandbox credentials
known_limitations.impact: End-to-end paid upgrade path may be partially mocked in automated runs
